entries.label: Soldat cyborg Desperado — variante standard
entries.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept. Produce ONE full-body game sprite of the standard DESPERADO VARIANT cyborg soldier from Metal Gear Rising Revengeance 2013. The attached official Piggyback guide page is a visual reference ONLY: use the THIRD full-body soldier in the top row (grey/black cybernetic armor with RED markings and dark compound face visor). Do NOT use the green Default soldier or blue human policeman. Preserve that selected figure's characteristic grey metal curved chest panels, red shoulder/red limb markings, exposed dark artificial muscles between panels, cybernetic joint construction, black thigh pouches, grey segmented feet and the tan top/rear of the artificial skull with a dark faceplate. Show one soldier standing in a compact neutral fighting-ready stance facing screen RIGHT, three-quarter side view, holding the tan-and-black MAK-200 rifle diagonally low ready in both hands exactly following the reference's weapon proportions. Keep human cyborg proportions, no extra limbs, no cape, no giant pauldrons, no original redesign. Painted HD 2D fighting-game sprite with refined realistic materials, crisp contour and readable limb separation. Single isolated complete body, all feet, hands, rifle and top of head inside generous transparent margins, real alpha background. Portrait 1024x1536. No scene, no shadow platform, no UI, no text, no watermarks, no guide layout, no panels, no multiple views. Reconstruct the small reference details conservatively and faithfully; preserve the selected Desperado colorway.

notes: Figure standard Desperado identifiée dans le guide officiel, distincte du cyborg vert et de la police de Denver.
Corps entier, palette gris/rouge, crâne implanté, cou mécanique, viseur et fusil inspectés.
Traits rouges et architecture des petites plaques interprétés à partir d’une référence petite ; révision externe de fidélité requise.
Pose 2D statique ; aucune animation ni changement combat.
